title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Coordinate Geometry
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: In the standard $(x,y)$ coordinate plane, how many points are both 5 coordinate units from the origin and also 2 coordinate units from the line $y = 0$?
questions.explain: Points 5 units from the origin lie on the circle $x^2 + y^2 = 25$. Points 2 units from the line $y = 0$ (the x-axis) lie on the horizontal lines $y = 2$ and $y = -2$. Substituting $y = 2$ or $y = -2$ into the circle's equation gives $x^2 + 4 = 25 \implies x^2 = 21 \implies x = \pm\sqrt{21}$. This yields four distinct intersection points: $(\sqrt{21}, 2)$, $(-\sqrt{21}, 2)$, $(\sqrt{21}, -2)$, and $(-\sqrt{21}, -2)$.
